name: Jade Dragon, Young
body:
YOUNG JADE DRAGON
CR 5

XP 1,600
NG Medium dragon (earth)
Init +0; Senses dragon senses, greensight 60 ft.; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 11, flat-footed 17 (+8 natural)
Hp 51 (6d12+12)
Fort +7, Dex +7, Will +6; Immune paralysis, sonic, sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 150 ft. (avg.), woodland stride
Melee bite +8 (1d8+1), 2 claws +7 (1d6+1), 2 wings +5 (1d4)
Special Attacks breath weapon (30 ft. cone, DC 15, 6d4 sonic)
Spell—Like Abilities (CL 6th; concentration +7)

At will—charm person (DC 12)

Spells Known (CL 1st; concentration +2)

1st (4/day)—entangle (DC 12), tripvine (DC 12)
0 (at will)—detect magic, detect poison, guidance, purify food and drink

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 10, Con 15, Int 12, Wis 13, Cha 12
Base Atk +6; CMB +7; CMD 17 (21 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Natural Armor, Lightning Reflexes, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Climb +13, Diplomacy +10, Fly +9, Intimidate +10, Knowledge (nature) +10, Perception +10, Stealth +9
Languages Draconic, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Graceful Flight (Ex)

A young adult or older jade dragon’s aerial maneuverability is one step better than normal.

Greensight (Su)

A young or older jade dragon can see through thick plant matter as though it were transparent, with a range of 60 feet. Greenery, leaves, undergrowth, and vines offer no concealment to the dragon’s sight, though solid wood still blocks its line of sight.

Spell—Like Abilities (Sp)

A young jade dragon can cast charm person as a spell-like ability at will.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and warm forests and jungles
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

Jade dragons are the guardians of untamed forests. They often consort with good—aligned druid circles and are benevolent with lost travelers as long as they respect wildlife.
